chunks.title: Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) (GGGI) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) is a Climate Finance Network / Public Facilitator headquartered in South Korea (Intergovernmental). At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Signed Nov 14, 2026 COP31 Antalya cooperation agreement with AIIB on climate-resilient infrastructure project preparation & green pipelines. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Joint AIIB–GGGI project preparation, technical assistance & investment-ready climate-resilient infrastructure pipeline mobilization. Source verification: https://www.aiib.org/en/news-events/news/2026/aiib-and-gggi-deepen-cooperation-climate-resilient-infrastructure-green-development.html.

chunks.title: GGGI Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) provides the following climate financing instruments: Project Preparation Technical Assistance, Green City Advisory, MDB Pipeline Origination (AIIB/GCF). Typical transaction ticket range is USD 250,000 to USD 50,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Sovereign/Government, Municipality, Climate-Tech Startup, Project SPV.

chunks.title: GGGI Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI): Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Zero Waste & Circular Economy, Air Quality & Green Growth, Renewable Energy. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Emerging Markets, Developing Countries, Türkiye, Asia, Africa, Latin America. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: GGGI Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete GGGI's application form: Host-country / municipal green-growth policy alignment; Clear path from technical assistance/pilot to AIIB or GCF bankable scale; Measurable GHG, air quality, waste, or resilience KPIs. Explicit exclusion rules: Fossil-fuel expansion. Official application portal: https://gggi.org/.

chunks.title: GGGI Form Template: Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form
chunks.text: Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) uses the 'Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form' workflow governed by IFC Performance Standards / Harmonized DFI Climate Reporting (10by30 / IDFC). Typical review timeline is 4–12 weeks (Screening -> Due Diligence -> Credit Committee). Form sections required: 1. Sponsor Profile, 2. Transaction Structure, 3. Climate & Impact, 4. Financial Due Diligence, 5. Risk Assessment, 6. Executive Summary.
